changeSet.author: archiv
changeSet.sql: create table public.mandant_budget ( mandant text not null, monat date not null, tokens_max bigint not null, tokens_verbraucht bigint not null default 0, constraint mandant_budget_pk primary key (mandant, monat), constraint mandant_budget_mandant_fk foreign key (mandant) references public.mandant (code), constraint mandant_budget_monat_ck check (extract(day from monat) = 1), constraint mandant_budget_tokens_ck check (tokens_max >= 0 and tokens_verbraucht >= 0) );
